also_nullable_when.source: computed from Black Diamond values and flows

words: The source table contract moves from 0.4.2 to 0.4.3. income_received gains the attribute also_nullable_when, whose value is the Black Diamond-computed source (computed from Black Diamond values and flows), so income_received may be null on that source, because that method separates no income and the Cottonwood adapter already writes it null. The nullable_when condition, the nullable false default and every other column, enum and section are unchanged; the one supersedes entry appended is 0.4.2, and rule24_record gains v043 with no enum member added. Both schema hashes are unchanged: they hash only the name and type of the columns and of the optional columns, and the recomputation with the contract's own method reproduces the 0.4.2 values. NOT PROVEN: that any producer writes, or any reader treats, the null correctly beyond the Cottonwood adapter that already writes it. No reader was run and no served table was read.
